summary: Removed hard-coded tool logic from resolve_action and genericized skepticism prompt to fix leakage.

edits.hypothesis: Removing hard-coded branching on specific tool names ('roi_crop', 'region_parse') in resolve_action eliminates task-specific leakage and prevents failures if tool registry changes.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The hard-coded logic is executable code, not just a prompt instruction; it must be removed from the source to comply with the constitution.
edits.trigger_condition: Always active when resolve_action is called.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) The agent will no longer rely on hard-coded tool interactions that may fail or leak specifics; instead, it relies on general tool validation. (preservative) Generic tool resolution preserves valid tool calls for other tasks. (transfer) Applies to any domain where tool registry might vary.
edits.regression_risk: Low; removes specialized logic that was causing leakage violations.
edits.mechanism: Removing hard-coded branching on specific tool names ('roi_crop', 'region_parse') in resolve_action eliminates task-specific leakage and prevents failures if tool registry changes.

edits.hypothesis: Genericizing the skepticism heuristic in AGENT_SYSTEM to remove references to specific tool capabilities ('cropping/zooming') prevents implicit leakage of toolset details while maintaining the core instruction to verify negative findings visually.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The prompt contained specific references to tool types ('cropping/zooming') which constitutes leakage of the available toolset's nature; genericizing it ensures compliance without losing the strategic intent.
edits.trigger_condition: Always active for M5 arm predictions using AGENT_SYSTEM.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) The agent receives a general instruction to verify negative findings via visual inspection, applicable regardless of specific tool availability. (preservative) Does not disrupt direct visual reasoning habits. (transfer) Generalizes to any diagnostic task with potential false negatives.
edits.regression_risk: Low; the instruction is more robust and less likely to cause confusion if specific tools are missing.
edits.mechanism: Genericizing the skepticism heuristic in AGENT_SYSTEM to remove references to specific tool capabilities ('cropping/zooming') prevents implicit leakage of toolset details while maintaining the core instruction to verify negative findings visually.
